name: Túpac Huallpa
role: First puppet Sapa Inca of the Inca Empire
contribution: The first vassal Sapa Inca installed by the Spanish conquistadors, during the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire led by Francisco Pizarro.

checks.lead: Túpac Huallpa (alternatively Tupaq Wallpa or Huallpa Túpac); before July 1533 – October 1533), original name Awki Wallpa Túpaq, was the first vassal Sapa Inca installed by the Spanish conquistadors, during the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire led by Francisco Pizarro.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
